EmailTemplate.description: Pending approvals alert sent to configured queue members listing all approval items that have exceeded the configured pending threshold.

EmailTemplate.subject: Pending Approvals — Action Required
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello,
The following approval items have been pending for an extended period and require your attention.
Please log in and take any action necessary.
Regards, Salesforce Automation
